result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion thereafter. The amendment is targeted to post-expiry or termination obligations, does not disturb the existing cessation and confidentiality provisions, and is professionally drafted. Including Customer Content alongside Customer Data is a reasonable clarification of the material to be returned.
